find: for (const slice of slices) if (slice.cost < lightest.cost) lightest = slice;
replace: for (const slice of slices) if (slice.cost > lightest.cost) lightest = slice;
why: Placing each scope on the HEAVIEST worker serialises the whole manifest onto one worker while the others idle -- the pool then costs worktrees and saves nothing. The balance assertion (hud on one worker, loop and both on the other) is the case.
killedBy: partitionByScope balances by entry count, largest scope first onto the lightest worker, and keeps manifest order within a worker
partitionByScope drops empty workers when there are fewer scopes than jobs, and --jobs 1 is one slice in manifest order
